prompt: Create a NEW master introduction illustration for 'Meet Morgan' in an enterprise marketing workshop. Use the supplied reference ONLY for the exact recurring character and illustration style. Preserve Morgan: woman with chin-length dark bob, round glasses, warm medium skin, cream blouse and forest-green jacket. Match tactile cut-paper collage, subtle risograph grain, warm ivory, forest green, sage, muted terracotta and ochre. Landscape 3:2. A welcoming editorial portrait of Morgan at the start of her Tuesday, seated at her desk, looking toward the viewer with a thoughtful approachable expression, laptop, coffee, notebook and pencil. Around her, a balanced visual constellation of the day ahead: audience profile cards, signal chart, content folders, approval stamp, small request queue, a colleague collaboration vignette and an evening learning chart. Make these supporting details restrained, not a busy dashboard. Soft morning sunlight from a window. Present-day human marketing work, not futuristic automation. One cohesive scene, no panels. No words, letters, numbers, titles or logos. Central face and upper body clearly readable at small size, refined composition suitable as the hero image of a workshop introduction.
